cohort: 1,009,987 Chinese nulliparous women who delivered live term singletons during 1993-2010
finding: Higher gestational weight gain was monotonically associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery, including CDMR, among low-risk women.
mod_finding: Higher gestational weight gain was monotonically associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery, including cesarean delivery on maternal request, among low-risk women.
